description: Start an AI visibility sample for one app in one country, with the engines available for the run. Requires the ai:read scope. Uses one AI visibility run from the workspace's allowance; get_ai_visibility returns the result. One measurement per app runs at a time.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (empty = the app's first three countries)

name: run_ai_visibility_check
title: Run AI visibility check
